decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and fitting tightly with the core platform offer, this product is likely performing at or above aspiration and does not justify reallocating its resources yet.
The calculator addresses a central customer use case in the firm’s established domain, so with uncertainty reduced after launch it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
This product line still faces some portfolio-rationalisation risk across its models, but its close link to core capabilities and the platform strategy makes continued support more probable than exit.
As a complementary tool that supports surrounding tariff and market-process solutions, it is likely worth keeping unless results fall clearly below aspiration.
